summary: Inline round-2 review: Revision 1 makes substantial progress, but the four original blocking areas remain partially unresolved. Workspace conventions and source reuse check out; supplied Instagram observations were accepted without authenticated re-probing.
strengths: Plugin layout, Bun invocation, development-only TypeScript tooling, and attributed source material match the reference repositories.
Removes the archive-only privacy assumption, specifies profile cleanup on logout, and binds live tests to an account.
Adds bounded transcode polling, explicit unsupported-operation errors, and descriptive analytics safeguards.
Current client code implements the named authentication headers and WWW-Claim refresh; cookie handling preserves mid and ig_did.

blocking_findings.title: Credential isolation still fails open
blocking_findings.why: Protect the credential directory and Chrome profile before storing credentials, and stop if protection cannot be established. A warning after writing plaintext does not resolve the original account-security finding.
blocking_findings.evidence: Revision 1 protects only the cookie file after writing and merely warns on failure. Current cookie-store.ts does the same; auth.ts creates the profile without explicit protection. Removing inherited ACEs and replacing one user's grant does not remove other explicit grants. See [Microsoft's icacls documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/icacls).

blocking_findings.title: GraphQL discovery does not establish usable read contracts
blocking_findings.why: Finding persisted-query IDs does not establish variables, response normalization, or pagination. Require representative contract fixtures and successful paginated reads before enabling dependent audit/research capabilities; otherwise explicitly defer those capabilities.
blocking_findings.evidence: Revision 1 labels variable shapes EXPERIMENTAL but retains the full read scope. Current graphql.ts defines adapters only for profile posts and search, with heuristic response-root selection. The plan still lacks operation-specific acceptance criteria for profile, media, comments, and pagination.

blocking_findings.title: Mutation schemas and verification gates remain incomplete
blocking_findings.why: Printed status labels do not establish working mutations. Specify complete web-specific payloads and keep each unproven operation disabled until its own approved test passes. A photo/delete test cannot validate carousel, reel, story, edit, comment, or reply.
blocking_findings.evidence: The story contract lists configure_mode/source_type but omits upload_id and the remaining body. Photo configure does not establish crop/source-dimension requirements, and sidecar child metadata/encoding remains unverified. Legacy delete/comment paths are explicitly unverified; contemporary comment mutations may require Relay GraphQL. Only one photo publication/deletion is tested. No supplied observation establishes successful mutation bodies.

blocking_findings.title: Caption-based recovery cannot safely reconcile ambiguous writes
blocking_findings.why: A matching caption can identify an unrelated post; no match does not prove failure because reads can lag or fail. Stories are absent from the ordinary post feed. Preserve an unresolved operation state and prohibit retry until operation-specific reconciliation or explicit manual resolution.
blocking_findings.evidence: Revision 1 checks only the account's latest post for the caption before offering a retry. It does not define reliable identity matching, a reconciliation window, story recovery, or tests for committed writes whose responses were lost.

non_blocking_findings.title: Account-stop safeguards need broader executable coverage
non_blocking_findings.why: Test that REST fallbacks, GraphQL bootstrap, polling, and cleanup stop on rate limits or challenges. Include token redaction in form bodies, not only Cookie/CSRF headers.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Revision 1 adds a dry-run fetch spy but does not specify these failure-path tests. GraphQL introduces fb_dtsg/lsd form tokens, while preview redaction names only headers.

non_blocking_findings.title: The base plan still contradicts its revision
non_blocking_findings.why: Consolidate superseded requirements so implementation and test authors have one authoritative specification.
non_blocking_findings.evidence: Earlier sections retain 429 backoff, 30 hashtags, and archive_only photo testing; Revision 1 replaces all three.

open_questions: Which capabilities must pass live verification for v0.1, and which will remain disabled?
Can sanitized web request/response fixtures establish complete configure and GraphQL contracts without retaining session tokens or account identifiers?
